reviewDependencyPackages.storage: Nullable document_reviews.dependency_package. NULL is legacy, never backfilled; every new INSERT captures version-1 dependencies atomically. Existing whole-row immutable guard and parent SELECT RLS apply.
reviewDependencyPackages.closure: Only reachable variable definitions/defaults/output overrides, condition categories/referenced values/policies, project or authorized same-workspace shared reusable metadata/exact persisted body revisions and transitive closure. Original JSON/reference identities remain unflattened.
reviewDependencyPackages.consistency: Single STABLE package function and STABLE recursive reads share one statement MVCC snapshot for all catalogs. Existing document/membership locks and stale expected timestamp checks remain. No claim of equality with a prior browser dependency preview or locking all catalog edits.
reviewDependencyPackages.security: No new definer/grants/public RPC. Private invoker helpers, empty search_path, no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated EXECUTE. Insert capture checks postgres transition context, auth identity, submitter and explicit Admin/Author role. Exact project/tenant scope checked for every dependency.
reviewDependencyPackages.schema: schemaVersion=1, resolverVersion=1, canonicalization=spextar-json-v1; organization/workspace/project IDs; neutral conditions/default variables/no selected output; UUID-ordered variables/categories/values/reusable arrays. Safe-integer JSON canonical domain, UTF-16 sorted object keys, significant array order, UTF-8 encoding; no digest execution.
reviewDependencyPackages.bounds: Eight reusable levels; ancestor cycles/ninth level fail; repeated DAG paths permitted. 256 distinct reusable IDs, 4096 body visits, 30000 nodes/body, 100000 visited nodes, JSON depth<100, dependency JSONB text<=16MiB. Missing/unsupported/unsafe/out-of-scope dependencies fail closed.
reviewDependencyPackages.review: Frozen provider performs no mutable dependency or reusable-body reads; Author/demo continue current resolution. Legacy semantic reviews show an explicit unavailable notice. Approval/Start New Draft preserve evidence; resubmission captures a new package.
reviewDependencyPackages.limits: No live migration/schema/Auth/RLS certification, multi-session race execution, release creation/digest, deployment or UAT. Optional in-memory PGlite SQL harness uses synthetic Auth, not live Supabase.

reviewLifecycle.transitions: Admin/Author submits Draft or starts new Draft from latest Approved; Reviewer/Admin decides expected active review. Changes requested requires note.
reviewLifecycle.enforcement: One document row lock per transition; working-write triggers serialize direct/tree/body writes. Explicit project role checked under membership row lock. Private definer implementation, empty search_path, postgres owner, authenticated EXECUTE only; invoker public wrappers. Browser must not send raw lifecycle status changes.
reviewLifecycle.limits: No migration application/replay, live RLS/Auth/multi-session validation or deployment performed. Restrictive review FKs preserve evidence and can block parent deletion.

projectManagement.enforcement: is_project_admin reads current project_members for auth.uid(), exact project_id and role admin. Its only consumers are projects UPDATE/DELETE and project_members INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies; UPDATE checks both existing and proposed scope. Parent administration alone does not grant these mutations.
projectManagement.bootstrap: create_project remains an invoker atomic RPC. The creator may insert only their own first admin membership into a project with no memberships. Established projects retain the last-admin trigger; removed/demoted creators cannot use bootstrap to regain administration.
projectManagement.preserved: Inherited parent administration/read visibility, explicit Admin/Author content writes, Review submit/start-Draft Admin/Author and decide Admin/Reviewer, organization-owner safeguards, last-project-admin trigger and restrictive review evidence FKs.
projectManagement.limits: No PostgreSQL execution, replay, live RLS/Auth or concurrent-session verification. Revocations committed before the statement are checked from database membership, not cached client/JWT roles; this does not claim serialization of every concurrent revocation. Parent deletion cascades retain historical behavior. No new member-onboarding or project-relocation contract.

document_reviews.authorization: Project members may read immutable evidence through tenant-safe RLS; no authenticated direct writes. Source-only Issue #9 migration; not live certified.

profiles.authorization: Own authenticated profile during session hydration; auth-user linkage and profile trigger expected, exact SQL unavailable.

organizations.authorization: Reads require organization membership; owner/admin may edit; permanent deletion is owner-only. Fresh membership checks supplement RLS. Creation remains atomic RPC only; no organization archive state.
organizations.limitations: Parent deletion relies on live database dependencies/triggers. No client-side child or membership cleanup. Exact applied SQL remains unavailable; isolated checks are not live RLS/cascade certification.

organization_members.authorization: Current identity membership. Bootstrap owner membership is protected by the established backend contract.

workspaces.authorization: Workspace admin or inherited organization owner/admin manages details and active/archived status. Permanent delete additionally requires archived state. RLS remains authoritative; atomic creation is unchanged.
workspaces.limitations: Lifecycle requires status active/archived, never substitutes demo data or fabricates absent status. Exact live status constraint/FK SQL is not independently certified by this repository.

workspace_members.authorization: Accessible workspace membership. Workspace admin is not an implicit project author.

projects.authorization: Accessible workspace/project reads; metadata updates and direct deletion only by explicit Project Admin. Source-only Issue #17 helper correction excludes inherited Org/Workspace Admin mutation authority. Creation uses atomic RPC.

project_members.authorization: Project/inherited members read; explicit Project Admin manages memberships. Source-only Issue #17 limits creator self-admin bootstrap to an empty project. Client candidates are existing accessible workspace members; no invitation workflow or new database target-user eligibility rule.

documents.authorization: Project access for reads; explicit Project Admin/Author may mutate Draft only. Lifecycle transitions use checked review RPCs; metadata cannot advance status. Create/duplicate use existing RPCs. New database guards are source-only.
documents.limitations: Metadata autosave is not revision-CAS; updated_at guard is for deletion. Only empty documents may be deleted by the application; FK actions/atomic dependency guarantees are unverified.

topics.authorization: Project access through document; explicit Project Admin/Author may mutate only while the document is Draft. Review transitions set topic statuses atomically. Tree operations and creation/duplication use RPCs; new lock triggers are source-only.
topics.limitations: Parent must be same-document and acyclic; server tree functions maintain hierarchy/order. Metadata autosave is not revision-CAS. Only leaf deletion; cascading draft/child relationships not certified.

topic_drafts.authorization: Authenticated identity and document/topic/project/status checked; explicit Project Admin/Author writes only in Draft. Review reads immutable evidence, never this table. New database write locks remain source-only.
topic_drafts.serverBehavior: Insert establishes revision 1; update trigger advances revision. RETURNING confirms the row; zero-row expected-revision update or duplicate first insert is conflict. No save RPC.

project_variables.authorization: Project access reads; explicit Project Admin/Author writes. Output Preview never writes.
project_variables.limitations: No optimistic revision/timestamp write guard; no deletion or semantic references.

condition_categories.authorization: Project access reads; explicit Project Admin/Author writes.
condition_categories.limitations: Management only, not persisted content assignment/resolution; no CAS or delete.

condition_values.authorization: Category checked in the current project; explicit Project Admin/Author writes.
condition_values.limitations: Nonnegative sort order, no reorder RPC/transaction or uniqueness guarantee inferred.

reusable_contents.authorization: Workspace-shared mutation uses workspace-admin authority; project mutation requires explicit Project Admin/Author.
reusable_contents.limitations: Project writes also filter project_id. Scope/slug identity cannot change on update. Duplication is client-orchestrated, not atomic; a body-copy failure may leave a metadata copy and explicit warning.

reusable_content_drafts.authorization: Parent reusable scope/authority checked; read-only roles cannot save.
reusable_content_drafts.serverBehavior: Database owns audits and revision: first insert 1, subsequent expected-revision update exactly +1. Zero-row update/duplicate first insert is conflict; no save RPC.

rpcs.atomicInvocation: Authoritative live F0/F1 names and named parameters, one authenticated RPC POST only. Workspace/project description is optional and sent as null when omitted. No signature discovery, aliases, direct entity inserts or client membership inserts.
rpcs.documentTopicInvocation: Verified named parameters, one authenticated RPC POST per action. No signature discovery, hint parsing, aliases, retries or direct insert fallback. Existing project/document/topic scope and authoring-role checks precede writes.
rpcs.authority: Atomic F0/F1 and document/topic callable names and named parameters are confirmed by the supplied authoritative live contracts; this does not certify current live SQL/RLS implementation. Review lifecycle RPCs are new source-only contracts, not applied or live-certified.
rpcs.returns: F2 creators/duplicators require a nonempty UUID string. Move/promote/demote do not consume a return value. Atomic F0/F1 create accepts string or id/entity_id record, then verifies bootstrap membership.
